name: internal subagents may coordinate
includes: Subagents may communicate with each other, but no agent may communicate with a person.
Launch as many workers concurrently as the host allows.

name: external communication stays forbidden despite authorization
includes: Human-directed messages, comments, replies, email, and chat posts are always forbidden.

name: subagent fan-out has a sequential fallback
includes: If the host cannot spawn subagents, execute the slices sequentially

name: candidate isolation has a local-draft fallback
includes: If isolation is also unavailable, keep candidates as clearly separated drafts

name: agent voting cannot decide user-owned preferences
includes: Do not let agent votes, model diversity, or the cross-judge settle a preference that only the user can own.

name: adapted TypeScript guidance works without sibling skills
includes: If `$principle-type-system-discipline` is available, apply it first. Otherwise use this skill's rules directly

name: design-space exploration does not imply a Git commit
includes: Compare them side by side. Only then choose.

name: foundational increments keep commit authority explicit
includes: Create commits only when the user or invoking workflow explicitly authorizes them.

name: reader-load guidance has a standalone context fallback
includes: otherwise keep large payloads out of the main context and retain only useful summaries

name: shared-state separation preserves internal coordination and Git authority
includes: Subagents may communicate with each other, but no agent may communicate with a person.
This principle does not authorize Git mutations.
